definitions.explanation: A lightweight blanket made of terry cloth (towel fabric), widely used in Japan as summer bedding. The name is a Japanese-coined English blend of "towel" and "blanket."

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧タオルケット⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
examples.english: In summer I sleep with a towel blanket.

examples.japanese: タオルケット⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗濯|せんたく}する→洗濯する：09656_sentakusuru⟧。

⟦{蒸|む}し{暑|あつ}い→蒸し暑い：03751_mushiatsui⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代|か}わり→代わり：01296_kawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧タオルケット⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掛|か}けて⟦{寝|ね}ている→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
examples.english: On hot, humid nights I sleep with a towel blanket instead of a futon.

notes:
A wasei-eigo (Japanese-coined English) combining "towel" and "blanket." Not used or understood in English.

USAGE:
タオルケット is a staple of Japanese summer bedding. Made of absorbent terry cloth, it is lighter than a ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧ or ⟦{毛布|もうふ}→毛布：03630_moufu⟧ and ideal for Japan's hot, humid summers. Most Japanese households switch from heavy bedding to a タオルケット around June and use it through September. It is also popular as a baby blanket year-round.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- タオルケット⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掛|か}ける: to put on a towel blanket
- タオルケット⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧: just a towel blanket (minimal summer bedding)
- ⟦{綿|めん}→綿：03807_men⟧100%⟦の→の：09472_no⟧タオルケット: 100% cotton towel blanket
- {今治|いまばり}タオルケット: Imabari towel blanket (premium brand from Ehime Prefecture)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{毛布|もうふ}→毛布：03630_moufu⟧: blanket — heavier, typically wool or synthetic, used in colder months
- {肌掛|はだか}け{布団|ぶとん}: thin summer quilt — a lightweight quilt, slightly thicker and warmer than a towel blanket
- ⟦{掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}→掛け布団：07014_kakebuton⟧: comforter, duvet — standard year-round bedding, much heavier
